question: For treatment of which of the following is the bark of the Arjuna tree primarily used?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Heart Disease**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The bark of the **Arjuna tree** is primarily used for the treatment of heart disease.
 
• It has been used in **Ayurvedic medicine** for centuries to support cardiovascular health.
 
• The bark contains compounds that help in strengthening the heart muscles
